result.summary: Found 1 issue: a missing icon inside the circular button in the top-right header.

issues.description: The circular button in the top-right corner of the header has a red notification badge dot, but its main icon (e.g., bell, cart, or profile icon) is missing, leaving an empty gray circle.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the SVG or icon asset for the top-right header action button loads properly and has appropriate color contrast against the light gray background.
